findings.title: Capability declaration does not match what the server serves
findings.why: The capabilities block is the contract the host negotiates with. Declaring `tools: {}` and then answering `tools/list` means the client never agreed to tools, so list-change notifications go nowhere and some hosts keep a stale catalog. The reverse — advertising tools with no `tools/call` handler — gives the model a catalog it cannot invoke.
findings.fix: Declare what the server really serves: `capabilities: { tools: { listChanged: true } }`, and implement every tool listed.
findings.evidence: capabilities assembled at runtime
findings.detail: inconclusive: registration is dynamic, read it by hand
